contact.faqSubtitle: Essential questions learners often ask before reaching out to Harry English House
contact.q1: Can I register for consultation if I don't know my current level?
contact.a1: Absolutely! You don't need any prior preparation. Once we receive your info, Harry English House will arrange a complimentary 4-skill assessment to diagnose your baseline and recommend the exact cohort.
contact.q2: Does Harry offer Online classes and is quality guaranteed?
contact.a2: Yes. Online classes at HEH are conducted via licensed platforms with 100% two-way live interaction. Every lesson is recorded for review, and writing tasks receive meticulous 1-on-1 feedback just like offline classes.
contact.q3: What is the typical class size at HEH?
contact.a3: HEH strictly adheres to small-cohort models of 6–10 students (or 1-on-1, 1-on-2 mentoring). This ensures ample speaking time and thorough individual corrections for Task 1 & Task 2 writing.
contact.q4: How quickly will I receive a response after submitting?
contact.a4: Our academic team and Mr. Harry will contact you via Phone/Zalo within a maximum of 24 business hours from your submission.
